title: 第849章 归宗第848章 裂缝出口
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
彻底脱离混乱虚空的那一刻，脚下重新踩上了坚实的力量依托——虽然是虚空中的灵力托举但跟裂缝里那种没有上下左右的虚无感完全不同。头顶是辽阔长空，脚下是无垠深海，海风迎面拂来带着湿润清冽的灵气扑面灌入肺腑。天地规则恢复正常了，上下左右前后方位全部归位，连头顶的太阳都是正常的暖色调。
桃夭夭在宁知初踏出裂缝的瞬间就松了一大口气。虽然一路上她只是在簪子里待着什么力都没出，但光是看着那些乱流就已经足够让人紧张了。木簪轻轻震动了一下传出她欢快得不行声音：出来啦！终于出来啦！太刺激了！第一次走空间乱流我这辈子都忘不掉！看着到处都是危险结果全程稳稳当当一点伤都没受，太神奇了！
宁知初笑着站定身形感受了一下海风和灵气：说了有惊无险不会骗你。这趟返程算是带你体验了一把两界夹缝的凶险。以后你要是再遇到类似的场景也有心理准备了。
桃夭夭感慨万分：我提前体验过大佬级别的跨界方式了！以后普通修士跟我吹什么秘境多凶险我都不带怕的！我可是穿过空间裂缝的树！
肩头的小乌龟慢悠悠地伸了伸四肢。它刚才在裂缝里趴着一动不动全程僵硬得像块石头，现在出来之后整个龟都松弛了一些，四肢从壳里伸出来在宁知初肩上舒展了一下又缩回去。它慢悠悠地开口说了六个字：说了会保你安全的。
芥子空间里的三小只也纷纷感慨开了。
小岚在空间里原地蹦了两圈瓜子壳撒了一地：太简单了！比上次主人第一次走的时候轻松太多了！主人变强真的超多！上次走完出来的时候主人衣角都碎了头发也散了，这次出来衣裳整整齐齐发型都没乱！
只只温柔地拍着小爪子眼睛里亮晶晶的：全程安安稳稳看着凶险实则稳稳当当，真好。而且这次有夭夭姐跟我们聊天没觉得那么紧张了。
小青盘在枝头淡淡总结：主人境界碾压路况熟悉加之前辈指路，三重稳妥自然无虞。这条裂缝对主人而言已然不算威胁了。
宁知初站在无边海的高空上俯瞰着茫茫海域。海水在下方翻涌着深蓝色的浪头一波接一波地推向天际线尽头，海面上空飘着几缕薄薄的白云，阳光从云隙间漏下来碎成万千金色的光斑。风从远处吹过来带着海水的咸腥和灵气混合的气息。
这片海域她很熟悉。再往前飞就是她当年渡劫无数次的雷域岛方向，再往远处就是无边海的边缘和神隐大陆的海岸线。五十年了，她在东华逛了五十年走过了那么多地方认识了那么多人，如今站在这里回头看去竟然有种恍若隔世的感觉。
她把目光从远处的海天交界线上收回来，开口时语气轻快带着一种终于回来了的淡淡安心感：走吧，最后一段路了。
桃夭夭在簪子里问：回家？
宁知初微微点头，嘴角弯了一下：嗯，回家。
她脚下轻轻一踏身形掠起朝着神隐大陆的方向飞去。海风迎面灌满衣袖和发间，肩上趴着小乌龟发间别着桃木簪，芥子空间里三小只还在叽叽喳喳地讨论回去之后第一顿饭吃什么。
无边海在脚下翻涌着无声无息地向后退去。阳光铺满了海面碎成流动的金色一直延伸到视野尽头的那条线上。
横渡无边海的过程比宁知初预想的还要顺利。她从空间裂缝踏出来的位置刚好在无边海的中间偏东段，距离神隐大陆的东海岸线不算太远。有了第一次横渡的经验和如今渡劫巅峰的修为打底，这片海域的凶险在她面前如同被大幅削弱的副本一样轻松。偶尔有几头不长眼的深海妖兽远远感知到她的气息就掉头跑了，跑得比什么都快，连头都不敢回。
她甚至还有闲心在半路上拐了个弯去雷域岛上空看了一眼。那座岛依旧被漫天紫黑色的雷霆笼罩着，电光轰鸣雷声滚滚，跟五十年前她离开时一模一样。她在岛外悬空站了片刻没有靠近也没有说话，只是安静地看了看然后转身走了。岛上的雷霆依旧自顾自地劈落着，沉默如初。
踏上神隐大陆东海岸线的那一刻，那种熟悉的、带着禁制压抑感的天地气息扑面而来。灵气的浓度确实比东华大陆稀薄了不少，天地之间好像笼罩着一层无形的罩子把万物的上限都锁在了某个刻度以下。宁知初感受了一下这片天道的压制力，心想当初自己被卡在合体巅峰那么多年出不去，果然不是自己不行是规则太坑人。
她全程收敛了自身全部气息。渡劫巅峰的威压放在这片最高只能容纳合体期的天地里跟往鱼塘里扔了一头鲸鱼差不多，稍微外泄一点就能把周围所有修士压得喘不过气来。她把修为压得死死的，身形隐在云层之间不催动任何遁光，就那么慢悠悠地朝着天玄宗的方向飞去。

一路掠过山川河谷时她偶尔停下来看看下方熟悉的地貌。神隐大陆的山水跟东华那边比起来少了几分磅礴大气多了几分温润含蓄，远山轮廓柔和溪流蜿蜒曲折，村落城池散落在平原和山坳之间安安稳稳的。她认得底下那些地形的轮廓——这条河是她当年带徒弟历练时走过的那条，那座山是某次外出任务时路过歇过脚的，那片林子里她还曾追过一只跑得飞快的小妖兽。
走了五十年再回头看这些旧地竟然有种其实也没变太多的恍惚感。
肩头的小玄龟缩着脑袋安安静静趴着。它保持了巴掌大小的体型趴在她肩上看起来跟一颗灰扑扑的石头没什么区别，寻常修士哪怕擦肩而过也只会当它是普通的随身灵宠压根不会多留意。发髻上的桃木簪是桃夭夭所化的，一路上时不时用神识跟宁知初唠嗑两句解闷。
桃夭夭透过簪子的感知打量着下方的山川大地，传音中带着好奇：这就是你从小长大的大陆？灵气比东华稀薄不少啊，天地看着也压抑很多，头顶好像压着什么东西似的。
宁知初一边缓步飞行一边神识回她：这片大陆有禁制锁死上限，灵气自然比不上东华。住久了也就习惯了，当初第一次去东华的时候我还觉得那边灵气浓得呛鼻呢。
桃夭夭感慨：难怪你修为那么高了还要跑出去，这种地方确实困不住人。就像一棵桃树种在石头缝里，根再深也长不大，得找片好土才能成材。
content_en:
The moment he was completely out of the chaotic void, he once again stepped on a solid support of strength - although it was the support of spiritual power in the void, it was completely different from the sense of nothingness in the crack without up, down, left, and right. There is the vast sky above your head, and the boundless deep sea below your feet. The sea breeze blows in your face and fills your face with moist and refreshing spiritual energy. The rules of the sky and the earth have returned to normal, with all directions up, down, left, front and back returned to their normal positions, and even the sun above our heads has a normal warm color.
Tao Yaoyao breathed a sigh of relief the moment Ning Zhichu stepped out of the crack. Although she just stayed in the hairpin and exerted no effort along the way, just looking at the turbulence was enough to make people nervous. The wooden hairpin vibrated slightly and she heard her extremely cheerful voice: Come out! It’s finally out! So exciting! I will never forget the first time I experienced space turbulence! Seeing dangers everywhere, I managed to stay steady throughout the whole process without any injuries. It’s amazing!
Ning Zhichu smiled and stood still to feel the sea breeze and aura: I won't lie to you if I say there is no danger. This return trip will allow you to experience the dangers of being caught between two worlds. If you encounter a similar scene again in the future, be mentally prepared.
Tao Yaoyao was very emotional: I have experienced the boss-level cross-border method in advance! From now on, I won’t be afraid of ordinary monks telling me how dangerous the secret realm is! I am a tree that passes through the cracks in space!
The little turtle on the shoulder slowly stretched its limbs. It was lying motionless in the crack just now and was as stiff as a stone. Now that it came out, the whole turtle has relaxed a little. Its limbs stretched out from the shell, stretched on Ning Zhichu's shoulders, and then retracted. It slowly said six words: I will keep you safe.
The three little ones in the mustard space also sighed with emotion.
Xiao Lan jumped twice in the space and scattered the melon seed shells all over the floor: It’s so easy! It’s much easier than the last time the owner left for the first time! The master has become stronger a lot! When the owner came out last time, his clothes were all torn and his hair was scattered. This time when he came out, his clothes were neatly dressed and his hair was not messed up!
He only patted his little paws gently, his eyes sparkling: the whole process was safe and dangerous, but actually he was safe and sound, it was great. And this time I didn’t feel so nervous when Sister Yaoyao was chatting with us.
Xiao Qingpan concluded calmly on the branch: The master's realm is crushing, familiar with the road conditions, and the seniors guide the way. The triple safety is natural and safe. This crack is no longer a threat to the owner.
Ning Zhichu stood high in the sky above the boundless sea, overlooking the vast sea. The sea water surges below with dark blue waves pushing towards the end of the skyline one after another. A few thin white clouds float above the sea, and the sunlight leaks through the gaps in the clouds and breaks into thousands of golden spots. The wind blows from a distance, carrying the smell of salty seawater and spiritual energy.
She was familiar with this sea area. Flying further forward is the direction of Leiyu Island, where she had saved countless tribulations, and further away is the edge of the Boundless Sea and the coastline of the Shenyin Continent. It has been fifty years. She has been shopping in Donghua for fifty years and has traveled to so many places and met so many people. Now, standing here and looking back, she feels as if she is in another world.
She withdrew her gaze from the distant sea-sky junction, and spoke in a brisk tone with a faint sense of relief that she was finally back: Let's go, it's the last part of the journey.
Tao Yaoyao asked in the hairpin: Go home?
Ning Zhichu nodded slightly and curled his mouth: Well, go home.
She lightly stepped on her feet and flew towards the direction of Shenyin Continent. The sea breeze filled my sleeves and hair. There was a little turtle lying on my shoulder with a peach hairpin in its hair. In the mustard space, three little turtles were still chattering about what to eat for their first meal after returning.
The boundless sea surged beneath our feet and retreated silently. The sunlight covered the sea surface and broke into flowing gold that extended to the line at the end of the field of vision.
The process of crossing the boundless sea was smoother than Ning Zhichu expected. She stepped out of the rift in spaceThe location is just east of the middle of the boundless sea, not too far from the east coastline of the Shenyin Continent. With the experience of crossing the sea for the first time and the cultivation base that is now at the peak of crossing the tribulation, the dangers of this sea area are as easy as a greatly weakened copy in front of her. Occasionally, a few eyeless deep-sea monsters would sense her aura from a distance and turn around and run away, running faster than anything else, not even daring to look back.
She even had the leisure to turn a corner on the way and take a look over Leiyu Island. The island was still shrouded in purple-black thunder, with lightning roaring and thunder rolling, just like when she left fifty years ago. She stood dangling outside the island for a moment without approaching or speaking. She just looked at it quietly and then turned around and left. The thunder on the island was still chopping down on its own, silent as ever.
The moment we set foot on the eastern coastline of the Shenyin Continent, the familiar, restrained and oppressive atmosphere of heaven and earth hit our faces. The concentration of spiritual energy is indeed much thinner than that of Donghua Continent. There seems to be an invisible cover between heaven and earth, locking the upper limit of all things below a certain scale. Ning Zhichu felt the oppressive power of this piece of heaven and thought that when he was stuck at the peak of integration for so many years and couldn't get out, it was not because he was not good enough but because the rules were too deceptive.
She restrained all her aura throughout the process. Putting the pressure of the peak of transcending the tribulation in this world that can only accommodate the maximum integration stage is like throwing a whale into a fish pond. A little leakage can suppress all the monks around. She suppressed her cultivation so much that her figure was hidden among the clouds without triggering any escaping light, and she flew so slowly in the direction of Tianxuan Sect.
As she passed through mountains and river valleys, she occasionally stopped to look at the familiar landscape below. Compared with those in Donghua, the mountains and rivers of Shenyin Continent are less majestic and more gentle and subtle. The outlines of distant mountains are gentle and the streams are meandering. Villages and cities are scattered peacefully between the plains and mountain valleys. She recognized the outlines of the terrain below - this river was the one she walked through when leading her apprentices for training, that mountain was where she rested when she was on a mission, and she once chased a small monster that ran very fast in that forest.
After walking for fifty years and looking back at these old places, I feel like they haven’t changed much.
The little turtle on his shoulder lay quietly with his head curled up. It maintained a palm-sized body and lay on her shoulder, looking no different than a gray stone. Even if ordinary monks passed by it, they would just treat it as an ordinary spiritual pet and not pay much attention to it. The peach wood hairpin on the bun was made by Tao Yaoyao. Along the way, she used her spiritual consciousness to chat with Ning Zhichu from time to time to relieve her boredom.
Tao Yaoyao looked at the mountains and land below through the hairpin's perception, and her voice was filled with curiosity: Is this the continent where you grew up? The spiritual energy is much thinner than that of Donghua, and the world seems to be much more suppressed, as if there is something pressing on the top of his head.
While Ning Zhichu was flying slowly, his consciousness returned to her: This continent has restrictions and limits, so the spiritual energy is naturally not as good as Donghua. After living there for a long time, I got used to it. When I went to Donghua for the first time, I thought the spiritual energy there was so strong that it choked my nose.
Tao Yaoyao sighed: No wonder you have to run out when your cultivation level is so high. This kind of place really cannot trap people. Just like a peach tree planted in the cracks of rocks, no matter how deep its roots are, it won't grow big. It has to find a piece of good soil to grow.
